text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Phew♡ Totally nailed it!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Good work today, Trainer☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand that's why, since we worked so 
hard, taking like half a month off should 
be totally fine, right? ♡

“Yes, I certainly produced results. 
However, when I recall how my debut race 
went—”

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Toooooh!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: All right, that should do it☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *wheeze*, *gasp*, *huff*!! 
――Uuuugh!! Dammit!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*...!! Ah dammit, as soon as 
we get back, we're training...!!

She had the casual air of someone who had 
just finished a minigame, showing far less 
fixation on winning or losing compared to 
those around her.

Even so, she delivered results with her 
innate talent, giving herself a perfect 
score of one hundred.

"Having high self-esteem is wonderful, and 
honestly, things will probably work out 
for a while. But—"

Talent, effort, mental fortitude—all are 
demanded, and a harsh world where lacking 
even one means being cast out immediately.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Booo. Then at least give me a week! A 
week off!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whyyyy~?! Then what about five days!? Five 
days! Give me five days off~!

Still, she doesn't have a marshmallow 
heart that can be turned into pure grit 
just by talking to her.

What I can do right now is... steel my 
heart and hammer her into shape from the 
outside.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: It's just a regular three-day weekend—!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Stingy. And right now, my mental state is 
already super unstable, y'know!
choice_data_list: What!? S-So that's how it was...!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course~! I mean, reporters aren't 
crowding around me at all!

To be honest, having a horde of reporters 
crowd around for a debut race is 
practically unheard of, but...?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
A "genius" made her debut, you know?! 
Normally, there'd be so many people the 
whole street would be jammed tight!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Even on the way home, like an idol on a 
street shoot, y'know~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Make way for Pandora-san!" "Let her 
through!" I figured she'd have bodyguards 
like that, and that even going home would 
be super tough, but—

To reiterate, because they are talented, 
they have high self-esteem and aim high, 
which can lead to placing excessive 
expectations on themselves—

Guiding a girl with such a fragile 
marshmallow heart might be harder than 
anything else, but...!

To fulfill Fusaichi Pandora's own dream— 
to win many GIs and shine brilliantly!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hey, are you listening to me!?

Indeed, it was a debut race that renewed 
that determination.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're asking whether the Triple 
Crown or Triple Tiara route is better?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Duh, the Tiara route, of course! ♡

—A few days later, as a reward for her 
debut race, we visited the café she had 
requested.

I was just in the middle of reviewing the 
plan for the Classic tier, but...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, the Triple Crown route just feels 
so, like, madeleine and financier, 
y'know?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
The Tiara's like macarons, ribbon cakes, 
tanghulu, and pudding à la mode, right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
It's super sparkly, and it's a tiara, 
right? If I win the Triple Tiara, I feel 
like I'll be waaaay more sparkly too!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Plus, Ku-chan Senpai chose it too, of 
course!

...Regardless, if there's enough passion 
to make a snap decision, she should aim 
for the Tiara route. Speaking of prep 
races for the Tiara route...
choice_data_list:
Shall we go with the "Hanshin Juvenile 
Fillies"?

text_block_list.text:
A GⅠ race said to decide the Junior Class 
champion, and a premier race where 
up-and-coming Umamusume aiming for the 
Tiara route gather...!

"If we can defeat these formidable rivals 
here, it will give us great momentum 
heading into the Classic tier!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Okey-dokey.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: —Ah?! Wait!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
The cherry on your cake, Trainer! I wanna 
eat it! Gimme, pleeease♡

...At any rate, next up is the 'Hanshin 
Juvenile Fillies.'

As she happily munched on cherries, the 
days of somehow managing to keep her under 
control began once more.
